## ✨ Enhancement Summary

<!-- A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you're proposing. -->

## 🌿 Branch Info (Gitflow)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Base branch** | `develop` |
| **Feature branch name** | `feature/<short-description>` |

> **Gitflow note:** All new features branch off `develop` using the `feature/` prefix and are merged back into `develop` via a pull request. Features never branch off or merge directly into `main`.

## 🎯 Motivation & Problem Statement

<!-- Why is this enhancement needed? What problem does it solve? What value does it add? -->

## 💡 Proposed Solution

<!-- Describe your proposed implementation or approach. Be as specific as possible. -->

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

<!-- List any alternative solutions or features you considered, and why you ruled them out. -->

## 📐 Acceptance Criteria

<!-- Define what "done" looks like. Use concrete, testable statements. -->

- [ ] Given ... when ... then ...

## 🖼️ Mockups / Examples

<!-- Add screenshots, wireframes, or code snippets to illustrate the enhancement. -->

## 📋 Additional Context

<!-- Any other information, dependencies, related issues, or links. -->

## ✔️ Definition of Done

- [ ] Feature branch `feature/<name>` created from `develop`
- [ ] Implementation complete and meets all acceptance criteria
- [ ] Unit and/or integration tests written and passing
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, inline docs, etc.)
- [ ] PR opened targeting `develop`
- [ ] Code reviewed and approved
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
